# Sea-man.org

> Comprehensive maritime knowledge platform covering seafarer certification, ship repair and construction, naval engineering, and maritime industry news.

Sea-man.org serves maritime professionals with exam preparation (CES, CBT, Marlins, Delta, SETS tests), technical documentation on shipbuilding and repair, marine engineering resources, and current industry updates. The platform provides essential reference materials for ship officers, mechanics, and maritime workers.

## Key Topics

- Maritime Exams (CES, CBT, Marlins, Delta, SETS)
- Ship Repair Technology
- Shipbuilding
- Marine Engineering
- Vessel Construction
- Ship Equipment
- Hull Design
- Crew Certification
- Navigator and Mechanic Training
- ISM Code
- Arctic Navigation
- Thruster Systems
- Ship Coating Technology
- Emergency Repair Procedures
- Floating Docks

## Maritime Exams & Certification

- [Морские тесты онлайн: CES, CBT, Marlins, Дельта и SETS](https://sea-man.org/testy-dlya-moryakov): Maritime exam preparation platform with CES, CBT, Marlins, Delta, SETS tests for seafarer certification

## Ship Repair & Maintenance

- [Судоремонт - требования, подготовка, выполнение работ](https://sea-man.org/sudoremont): Ship repair guide covering requirements, preparation, and repair execution
- [Организация судоремонта - технология подготовки и надзора](https://sea-man.org/sudoremont/organizaciya-sudoremonta): Ship repair organization, preparation technology, and supervision procedures
- [Аварийный ремонт судна, справочник моториста-матроса](https://sea-man.org/sudoremont/avariynyy-remont-sudna): Emergency ship repair procedures and motorist-sailor reference guide
- [Технология судоремонта, особенности и общие понятия](https://sea-man.org/sudoremont/tehnologiya-sudoremonta): Ship repair technology, maintenance stages, and repair standards
- [Технология судовых покрытий и разновидность материалов](https://sea-man.org/sudoremont/tekhnologiya-sudovykh-pokrytiy): Ship coating technology, materials, and hull protection methods
- [Корпусные конструкции судна, описание основных элементов](https://sea-man.org/sudoremont/chtenie-chertezhej-korpusnyh-konstruktsij): Ship hull construction, blueprint reading, and structural elements
- [Монтаж судовых механизмов, оборудования и узлов](https://sea-man.org/sudoremont/montazh-sudovyh-mehanizmov): Ship mechanism assembly, equipment installation, and systems integration

## Shipbuilding & Naval Engineering

- [Технология судостроения - основные понятия и процессы](https://sea-man.org/sudostroenie): Shipbuilding technology, construction basics, and naval engineering
- [Морская инженерия, исследование и разработка проектов судов](https://sea-man.org/sudostroenie/morskaya-inzheneriya): Marine engineering, vessel design, project development, and innovation
- [Суда на подводных крыльях и воздушной подушке](https://sea-man.org/sudostroenie/morskaya-inzheneriya/suda-na-pk-i-vp): Hydrofoil and air-cushion vessels, design, and hydrodynamics
- [Суда ледового плавания, разработка и проектирование](https://sea-man.org/sudostroenie/morskaya-inzheneriya/suda-ledovogo-plavaniya): Ice-class ships, arctic navigation, hull reinforcement, and engineering
- [Подруливающие устройства судна, принцип работы и обозначение](https://sea-man.org/sudostroenie/sudovye-podrulivayushchie-ustroystva): Thruster systems, operating principles, and vessel maneuvering devices

## Vessel Types & Specialized Ships

- [Типы буксирных судов их устройства и оснащение](https://sea-man.org/sudostroenie/buksirnye-suda): Tugboat types, equipment, design, and towing system specifications
- [Плавучие доки: устройство, строительство и проекты](https://sea-man.org/sudostroenie/plavuchie-doki): Floating docks, construction, design, and ship repair facilities
- [Типы плавучих буровых установок, классификация ПБУ](https://sea-man.org/sudostroenie/tipy-plavuchih-burovyh-ustanovok): Floating drilling units, platform types, and offshore equipment

## Reference & Terminology

- [Marine Terms Definitions and Maritime Vocabulary List](https://sea-man.org/qa): Maritime vocabulary, nautical terms, abbreviations, and glossary reference

## Maritime News & Updates

- [Последние морские новости и события на Sea-man.org](https://sea-man.org/news/ru): Latest maritime industry news, shipping, shipbuilding, and vessel incidents
